# Optional vision sources

Vision adapters use these original projects/packages:
- Gesture model reference: https://github.com/Kazuhito00/hand-gesture-recognition-using-mediapipe
- Face recognition: https://github.com/ageitgey/face_recognition
- Object classification: https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics

Run scripts/setup_vision_repos.sh to clone the original repositories under vendor/.
Camera inference stays disabled by default; enable only what you need on a Pi 3B+.
